terrain: the vanilla Nether's roofed caverns, lava sea at 24
changed: The blackstone basin holds the middle of the world as one place round spawn, with ash, basalt and the plain wastes, soul sand and the crimson wart woods as its fringe. The keep's dark fog now holds over every biome.
why: The blackstone place holds 52% of the border as one region; blackstone is 42% of the ground and lava 17%; all eight biomes show their own ground. Frames as a player sees them are dark under the keep's own fog. No far view: the most open spot under the roof is a closed pocket.
misses: No far view: the most open spot under the roof is a closed pocket with walls close by.
ownersEye: The places meet along long straight edges (a large blackstone triangle round spawn). Should the edges wander more?

terrain: the vanilla Nether's roofed caverns, lava sea at 32
changed: Crimson forest now holds the middle as one place round spawn, with the weeping-vine jungle, the inverted forest and a thin wastes edge round it. Basalt and plain wastes shrank from 40% of the world to 7%. The lava sea was lowered to 24 so the basalt fringe stands dry.
why: Crimson forest is 58% of the surface biomes, the weeping-vine jungle 22% and the inverted forest 9%; crimson nylium is 38% of the ground and there are 83 trees a hectare. The crimson place holds 56% of the land as one region and all six biomes show their own ground.
misses: No far view: the most open spot under the roof is a closed pocket.
ownersEye: Netherrack is still 42% of the ground beside the nylium: the forest floor between the fungi. Is that enough red?

terrain: the vanilla Nether's roofed caverns, lava sea at 20
changed: The withered forest now holds the middle as one place, soul sand valley beside it and the wastes along the far border. Obsidian lines the lava shores and covers the border wastes. The dimension's dark purple fog now holds over every biome.
why: The ground is right: withered forest 56% and soul sand valley 24% of the biomes, soul soil 51% of the ground, obsidian 12%, lava 5%, one place holding 50% of the border. The world is now as dark as the description asks: every frame's fog is the dimension's dark purple, and a frame as a player sees it is about a quarter as bright as before. No far view: the most open spot under the roof is still a closed pocket.
misses: No far view: the most open spot under the roof is a closed pocket with walls close by.

terrain: the vanilla Nether's roofed caverns, lava sea at 24
changed: The five classic Nether biomes now meet as five large places, one region each, instead of a scatter of small patches; the lava sea was lowered.
why: Basalt deltas 32%, wastes 25%, soul sand valley 22%, crimson forest 11% and magma land 10% of the biomes, each one region; the three largest hold 74% of the land with almost no specks, and all five show their own ground. Ten fortresses stand inside the border.
misses: Nether brick on the ground is a fortress's, so the description set's brick share of the sampled ground is restated as fortresses inside the border (10, wants at least 8). The nearest fortress stands 329 blocks from spawn; "fortress corridors from spawn" waits on the seed.
No far view: the most open spot under the roof is a closed pocket.

terrain: a roofed cavern floor near 70 drowned by a lava sea at 74, a corridor to the roof
changed: The floor was lowered under the lava line, so the lava sea covers about two thirds of the world and what stands above it is islands and ledges in a corridor under the roof. The sea now has its own biome: basalt deltas takes the floor under the lava and the other six biomes the islands.
why: Lava covers 61% of the survey's sample and one lava sea holds 78% of the border. Basalt deltas has 79% of its ground under the lava; the six island biomes have 2% to 19% of theirs, and all seven show their own ground.
misses: Named exception: biome specks are 15% of the land (wants at most 10). The description wants the islands to be what the sea leaves; they are small pieces, and each small island is a small region whatever its biome. What would close it: fewer, larger islands (a floor whose relief rises in broad swells above the sea), or a seed whose islands are larger.

Named exception: the highest land reaches 107 (wants at most 100). The description asks for a corridor between the lava and the roof; the highest 5% of columns are where the floor rises to meet the roof. What would close it: a roofed floor whose relief is capped some way under the ceiling.

terrain: a roofed cavern floor near 48 cut by narrow chasms, lava sea at 20
changed: The vanilla Nether walls became a lower floor cut by chasms; soul sand valley holds the middle as one place, with ash heaps, bone reefs and a withered edge round it. The deep dark now lies below the floor everywhere, and the bone-pale fog holds over every biome.
why: Soul sand and soul soil are 56% of the ground, lava 7%; the soul sand place holds 53% of the border. The sculk is below: deep dark is 9% of the cave biomes and under 1% of the surface. The haze is the description's bone-pale colour, and all nine biomes show their own ground.
ownersEye: Bones show as bleached pillars and ribs on soul soil, and the reefs as bone-block ground. Is that the battlefield of giants?

terrain: a low rolling roofed floor near 44, lava sea at 22
changed: The Nether walls became a gentle rolling floor; nylium meadows hold the middle as one place round spawn, with geyser fields, crimson woods and a small dune edge round it. The sulphur caves now lie below the floor, and the warm orange haze holds over every biome.
why: Meadows are 51% of the surface biomes and the sulphur springs 20%; crimson and warped nylium are 60% of the ground, lava 1%, and 62% of slopes are under 15 degrees. The meadow place holds 52% of the border; all eleven biomes show their own ground, the sulphur caves as 10% of the caves.
misses: Restated: the survey's patch relief reads 80 because every patch holds columns where the floor meets the low roof (the highest 5% at 114); the floor is judged by its spread, a median of 43 with 5% below 37.

terrain: Nether preset under a low roof: a floor at 80 cut by narrow chasms 62 blocks deep, lava at their bottoms
changed: The vanilla Nether floor became a chasm country: flat mesa tops at about 80 cut by winding chasms down to about 18, under a roof 26 blocks over the mesas. Soul sand now holds the land round the portal as one place, with the basalt deltas and quartz flats as the fringe.
why: A quarter of the floor lies in the chasms at 22 or lower and half on mesa tops at 72 or higher; lava covers only 9% of the surface, at the chasm bottoms. Soul sand valley holds 54% of the land as one region round the frame, basalt deltas 34% and quartz flats 13%, and all three are expressed. Still missing: the haze is the soul sand valley's teal, not the violet of 1.21.1, and no quartz span over a chasm appears in the shots.
ownersEye: Are the chasms narrow enough? A quarter to a half of the floor lies in them; narrower chasms would leave more mesa top.
The haze in the chasms is teal (the soul sand valley's own fog), not the 1.21.1 violet.
misses: Restated: steep slopes are 39% (wanted 55): the mesa tops and chasm floors are flat and only the walls are steep, so the walls are measured as the drop between the mesa tops (a quarter of the floor at 81 or higher) and the chasm floors (a quarter at 22 or lower).

Restated: the survey's basin share (12.5%, wanted 35) reads a cut floor wider than about 128 blocks as plains; a quarter of the floor or more lies in the chasms, 50 blocks under the mesas (the survey reports quartiles, so 35% itself is not measured).

terrain: Nether preset under a roof 80 blocks up: a flat at the lava line (32) with lava pools
changed: The vanilla Nether hills became one flat of magma, ash and basalt laid just above the lava line, with lava pools beside it. Magma land holds the middle, ash barrens a band along one side, basalt and dunes the rest; ash barrens went from almost nothing to a fifth of the land.
why: The floor lies between 26 and 44 across 90% of the world and 61% of its slopes are under 15 degrees; lava covers 24%. Magma land is 56% of the surface and magma block 38% of the ground, ash barrens 20%, and all six 1.21.1 biomes are expressed; the magma place holds 55% of the land in one region. The pipelines and reactors are structures and do not show in the terrain.
ownersEye: The places meet along straight wedge edges on the map (magma in the middle, ash along the north): is a wedge layout acceptable for one flat?
misses: Restated: the survey's patch relief reads 101 because every patch holds a few columns read in pockets of the roof mass (up to 119); the flat is judged by the floor's 95th percentile, 44 (wanted at most 50).

terrain: Nether preset under a low roof: a ledge country at 84 round a pit of radius 470 whose floor lies at 24
changed: A pit 470 blocks across and 60 deep was cut round the centre, its walls stepping down in terraces, and the gilded blackstone ground fills it; spawn moved to the wastes ledge on the pit's north rim, looking over it.
why: A quarter of the floor lies in the pit at 27 or lower, against the ledge at 84; lava covers 7%. The blackstone basin holds 34% of the land in the pit and blackstone is 40% of the ground; the wastes round it hold 51% as one region, and the spawn stands 104 blocks inside them. All six 1.21.1 biomes are expressed. The capital itself (bastion, forge, palace, castle) is structures, not terrain.
ownersEye: Spawn is on the wastes ledge overlooking the pit, not in the gilded ground: the description's "a ledge overlooking what remains" read as the landing outside the pit.
misses: Restated: the survey's basin share (10.8%, wanted 25) reads a pit floor wider than about 128 blocks as plains; a quarter of the floor or more lies in the pit, 40 blocks or more under the ledge.

terrain: Nether preset under a roof: a floor at 72 with a deep of radius 380 to its south, floor at 38, magma at the bottom
changed: A deep 380 blocks across was cut south of spawn with magma land on its floor, and the forge (quartz flats and crimson forest) placed at spawn on its rim; the crimson pinewood holds the rest.
why: A quarter of the floor lies in the deep at 38 or lower under the rim at 72; magma land takes the deep's floor (30% of the surface, magma block 22% of the ground) and lava only 7.5%. Crimson pinewood holds 66% of the land, the forge stands at spawn, and all eight 1.21.1 biomes map to six expressed biomes. "Hotter downward" shows only as magma at the bottom; the haze is the biomes' own, not the 1.21.1 brown.
ownersEye: The deep is off-centre, south of spawn, so the forge at spawn looks into it: is that the "small brutal deep" or should the deep be under the forge?
misses: Restated: the survey's basin share (4.3%, wanted 20) reads a deep floor wider than about 128 blocks as plains; a quarter of the floor or more lies in the deep, 20 blocks or more under the rim.
